hardwareHubs.note: Trade press describes Warsaw as an orthopedic device manufacturing center with firms such as Zimmer Biomet and DePuy Synthes.
Elkhart County is reported to build about 80 percent of U.S. recreational vehicles.

makerspaces.name: Bloominglabs
makerspaces.note: Community space at 1840 S. Walnut Street whose site lists woodworking, electronics, welding, sewing and 3D printing.

makerspaces.name: Think It Make It Lab
makerspaces.note: IU Indianapolis lab with Trotec laser engravers, a CNC router and a plasma cutter for university students and faculty.

makerspaces.name: 4-H INDY Studio
makerspaces.note: Fairgrounds makerspace with 3D printers and a Glowforge laser cutter, aimed at youth and family programs.

programs.name: Purdue Foundry
programs.note: Purdue Research Foundation hub that supports Purdue-affiliated startups, including past hardware ventures such as Rabbit Tractors.

specialties.name: Orthopedic and medical devices
specialties.note: Warsaw is described as the orthopedic capital of the world, with medical device work across northeast Indiana.

specialties.name: Recreational vehicles
specialties.note: Elkhart County is reported to produce more than 80 percent of U.S. recreational vehicles.

support.name: Purdue Manufacturing Extension Partnership (Purdue MEP)
support.note: Indiana's MEP center offers lean, quality, cybersecurity and innovation help to manufacturers, though a 2025 op-ed expected its federal funding to end.
